title: Action
description: A single browser action the extension should execute.

target.description: Identifier of the page element to act on (used by click, fill, upload, press_key, select, scroll).

value.description: Literal value to use (for select, or non-sensitive fill). Prefer value_source for anything private.

value_source.description: Local profile reference the extension resolves on-device. E.g. 'local_profile.email', 'local_profile.resume'. Never resolved server-side.

key.description: Key or key combination for press_key (e.g. 'Tab', 'Enter', 'Ctrl+A').

duration_ms.description: Duration in milliseconds for wait actions.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector hint for the element.
